title: Integrated multi-omics and artificial intelligence to explore new neutrophils clusters and potential biomarkers in sepsis with experimental validation.
authors: Xu, Peng; Tao, Zuo; Zhang, Cheng
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用多组学与机器学习分析脓毒症中性粒细胞亚群及标志基因，虽涉及转录因子调控但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis, causing serious organ and tissue damage and even death, has not been fully elucidated. Therefore, understanding the key mechanisms underlying sepsis-associated immune responses would lead to more potential therapeutic strategies. METHODS: Single-cell RNA data of 4 sepsis patients and 2 healthy controls in the GSE167363 data set were studied. The pseudotemporal trajectory analyzed neutrophil clusters under sepsis. Using the hdWGCNA method, key gene modules of neutrophils were explored. Multiple machine learning methods were used to screen and validate hub genes for neutrophils. SCENIC was then used to explore transcription factors regulating hub genes. Finally, quantitative reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction was to validate mRNA expression of hub genes in peripheral blood neutrophils of two mice sepsis models. RESULTS: We discovered two novel neutrophil subtypes with a significant increase under sepsis. These two neutrophil subtypes were enriched in the late state during neutrophils differentiation. The hdWGCNA analysis of neutrophils unveiled that 3 distinct modules (Turquoise, brown, and blue modules) were closely correlated with two neutrophil subtypes. 8 machine learning methods revealed 8 hub genes with high accuracy and robustness (ALPL, ACTB, CD177, GAPDH, SLC25A37, S100A8, S100A9, and STXBP2). The SCENIC analysis revealed that APLP, CD177, GAPDH, S100A9, and STXBP2 were significant associated with various transcriptional factors. Finally, ALPL, CD177, S100A8, S100A9, and STXBP2 significantly up regulated in peripheral blood neutrophils of CLP and LPS-induced sepsis mice models. CONCLUSIONS: Our research discovered new clusters of neutrophils in sepsis. These five hub genes provide novel biomarkers targeting neutrophils for the treatment of sepsis.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症可导致严重的器官和组织损伤甚至死亡，但其机制尚未完全阐明。因此，理解脓毒症相关免疫反应的关键机制将有助于开发更多潜在的治疗策略。方法：研究了GSE167363数据集中4名脓毒症患者和2名健康对照者的单细胞RNA数据。拟时序轨迹分析了脓毒症下的中性粒细胞簇。使用hdWGCNA方法，探索了中性粒细胞的关键基因模块。采用多种机器学习方法筛选并验证中性粒细胞的核心基因。随后使用SCENIC探索调控核心基因的转录因子。最后，通过定量逆转录聚合酶链反应验证两种小鼠脓毒症模型外周血中性粒细胞中核心基因的mRNA表达。结果：我们发现两种新型中性粒细胞亚型在脓毒症下显著增加。这两种中性粒细胞亚型富集于中性粒细胞分化的晚期状态。对中性粒细胞的hdWGCNA分析揭示，3个不同模块（Turquoise、brown和blue模块）与两种中性粒细胞亚型密切相关。8种机器学习方法揭示了8个具有高准确性和稳健性的核心基因（ALPL、ACTB、CD177、GAPDH、SLC25A37、S100A8、S100A9和STXBP2）。SCENIC分析显示，APLP、CD177、GAPDH、S100A9和STXBP2与多种转录因子显著相关。最后，在CLP和LPS诱导的脓毒症小鼠模型外周血中性粒细胞中，ALPL、CD177、S100A8、S100A9和STXBP2显著上调。结论：我们的研究发现了脓毒症中的新型中性粒细胞簇。这五个核心基因提供了针对中性粒细胞治疗脓毒症的新型生物标志物。
